description: Seconds since midnight from an MS-DOS/FAT packed time (hour:5, minute:6, seconds/2:5)
notes: Real-world date/time idiom (FAT directory entries, ZIP headers); function written by us from the documented bit layout. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two multiplications (3600 and 60), masks and adds: 11 IR instructions. A variant that factors out the 60 (((t >> 5) - 4 * (t >> 11)) * 60 + 2 * (t & 31)) was tried by hand: proven correct by Alive2 but no gain in llvm-mca (309 vs 310 cycles per 100 iterations). Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
